text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — I promoted a candidate model (rwd-v6-lite-int4) into a phased induction plan in staging. Shadowed ~10k requests overnight. Planning a 2% pilot -> 5% canary if smoke looks ok. Need to lock gate thresholds and auto-fallback rules before pilot.
Marta Ruiz: Nice. Do we have smoke numbers? p95 latency, cost delta, and any obvious quality regressions?
Samir Patel: Short summary from the shadow run: latency p95 is up ~12% vs production v5 on our conv traffic, token cost down ~18% (quant gains). Longdoc MRR slice saw a -4% delta on a small sample (n=200). Hallucination checks on randomized anchors passed for now.
Jing Wu: Did you run the anchor eval suite (slice-aware) or just overall evals? Need slice breakdown for longdocs + rerank.
Alex Chen: Ran the anchor suite + the new rerank fidelity set. I'll paste the rollout config I'm proposing: 
```yaml
model: rwd-v6-lite-int4
phases:
  - name: shadow
    traffic: 0%
    evals: smoke
  - name: pilot
    traffic: 2%
    duration: 24h
    metrics:
      - name: latency_p95
        threshold: +20%    # relative to prod-v5
      - name: longdoc_mrr
        threshold: -2%     # slice-level must be >= -2%
      - name: hallucination_rate
        threshold: +1%
fallback:
  - metric: longdoc_mrr
    delta: -3%
    action: rollback
  - metric: hallucination_rate
    delta: +1%
    action: rollback
  - metric: latency_p95
    delta: +40%
    action: rollback
kv_cache_warmup: true
streaming: true
```
Marta Ruiz: That looks reasonable. Request: relax the latency_p95 threshold to +30% for pilot (we can tolerate some tail-cost for int4) but make the longdoc_mrr fallback stricter: rollback at -2.5% (slice-level). Also require auto-shadow-compare to run every 30m.
Samir Patel: +1 to Marta. Also add a guard for cold-start tail — observed a 2x spike on a small worker group when cache was empty. Could add a coldstart_kicker that pauses promotion if coldstart latency > x for 10m.
Jing Wu: We should add a slice-level monitor for rerank-precision@5 and an automated alert if precision drops >1.5%. That way we don't miss rerank regressions even if overall MRR looks ok.
Alex Chen: Good call. I'll change the config to include: slice_monitors: [longdoc_mrr, rerank_p@5] and schedule evaluations every 30m. Want auto-fallback to be strict on quality but lenient on latency.
ops-bot: FYI — Canary budget remaining: 80% of reserved pilot capacity.
deploy-bot: Scheduled pilot rollout for rwd-v6-lite-int4 at 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z -> traffic 2% (pilot). Canary escalation to 5% is manual after 24h if no rollbacks.
Marta Ruiz: Assigning actions: Alex -> update rollout config & add cache warmup flag; Samir -> run a focused longdoc micro-burn (n=2k) with kv warmup; Jing -> wire rerank precision monitor + alert. Ping me when done.
Samir Patel: I'll run the micro-burn now and post results in this thread in ~2h.
Alex Chen: Updated config pushed to staging repo, PR #452. Added coldstart_kicker (threshold: 1.8x baseline p95 for 10m) and 30m shadow-compare cron.
Jing Wu: Wiring alerts now. Will attach the rerank precision slice dashboard and a webhook to the rollout controller.
Samir Patel: micro-burn done: longdoc_mrr delta -2.1% (n=2k) with kv warmup enabled, p95 latency +18%. No hallucination uptick. I'll upload slice csv shortly.
Marta Ruiz: Thanks. Given -2.1% on longdocs I'm ok to proceed with pilot at 2% but we need rollback at -2.5% (slice) + auto-notify to oncall. Also include a cooldown: if a rollback happens, block re-promote for 48h.
Alex Chen: Ack — implemented rollback delta -2.5% and 48h cool-down. Notifying infra to reserve extra capacity for rollback runs.
deploy-bot: Pilot started (rwd-v6-lite-int4) — traffic:2% at 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z. Monitoring windows enabled.
Marta Ruiz: I'll watch the first 4h window. If any unexpected drift, we rollback immediately. :eyes:
